rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００２Okay, this part's done...￥Next up is this bit, I guess...
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００４See, I found a Worker that's￥scheduled to be scrapped...
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００５It still looks like it runs, so￥tossing it out like that seems￥so wasteful, don't you think?
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００６So if I can, I'd like to bring￥it back to life.
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００７Huh? ...Oh, it's you! Nope.￥I'm not training. I'm doing￥maintenance on this Worker.
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００８This little guy... oh! I mean,￥this Worker is going to be￥scrapped, but...
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿００９But if I fix it up, it'll￥still run just fine.＝＠０１５＿０１０So if I can, I'd like to bring￥it back to life.
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿０１１I really love Workers and stuff.＝＠０１５＿０１２When you take care of a Worker,￥it pays you back for every bit￥of effort you put in!
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿０１３Machines are like living things.￥Give them love, and they'll￥love you right back!
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿０１６Hearing you say that makes me￥so happy!!
＊Amane＊＠０１５＿０１８Ummm... I don't know what other￥people think, but that's how￥I feel!
＊Natsuno＊＠０１６＿００２Ah! Amane!!￥It's dangerous to mess with a￥scrapped Worker on your own!
＊Natsuno＊＠０１６＿００５What if you make a mistake and￥get seriously hurt?!
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿００９It's not like I didn't know￥what I was doing.
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０１０I'm a certified mechanic too,￥you know...＝＠０１６＿０１１I've seen the blueprints, and I￥think I've got a good handle on￥how Workers are built.
＊Natsuno＊＠０１６＿０１３You're right. I'm sorry.￥You're certified too, Amane.
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０１４Yeah, I know. But I just￥kind of lost my temper...
＊Natsuno＊＠０１６＿０１６I should be the one apologizing.￥You're right, you're certified￥too, Amane...
＊Natsuno＊＠０１６＿０１７I never meant to look down on￥you, not at all. It's just...＝＠０１６＿０１８When I think something's risky,￥I get worried, and I end up￥butting in.
＊Natsuno＊＠０１６＿０１９Sorry for getting in your way.＝＠０１６＿０２０Well, good luck!
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０２１I was mean to Natsuno.￥She was only trying to help me,￥wasn't she?
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０２２I'm so short-tempered...￥Not very manly of me.
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０２３"Only a child loses his temper￥so fast." Dad always told me￥that, and I still did it.
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０２４I've still got a lot￥of growing up to do...
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０２５Yeah, you're right.￥I've gotta try even harder!
＊Amane＊＠０１６＿０２７Ah!! Oh no!＝＠０１６＿０２８I wanted to finish fixing it￥so it'd be ready tomorrow!
